title: ज़्यादा अच्छा बनना भी मूर्खता है
description: ज़्यादा अच्छा बनना भी मूर्खता क्यों है, और लोग आपकी अच्छाई का फ़ायदा कैसे उठाते हैं। अच्छे बनिए, पर समझदार भी। #shorts #motivation #lifelessons #hindi #psychology
hook: ज़्यादा अच्छा बनना मूर्खता क्यों है?

scenes.narration: ज़्यादा अच्छा बनना भी मूर्खता है, और ये बात दुनिया आपको कभी नहीं बताएगी।
scenes.image_prompt: A young Indian man in his late twenties with short black hair, a kind round face and warm brown eyes, wearing a mustard-yellow kurta, stands alone in the centre of a crowded old market lane at golden hour, holding a heavy wooden tray of glowing tea glasses outward with both hands, smiling warmly while several shadowy figures reach in from every side and take things from the tray. His eyes look tired beneath the smile. Foreground: scattered marigold petals on worn cobblestones. Middle ground: colourful shop awnings, hanging lanterns and strings of paper flags. Background: hazy rooftops under a peach and orange sunset sky with soft light rays. Warm gold and coral tones with deep teal shadows. Hand-painted gouache and watercolor storybook illustration with visible brushstrokes, soft paper texture, rich harmonious colours and cinematic light.

scenes.narration: जो हर बार हाँ कहता है, लोग उसे इंसान नहीं, सुविधा समझने लगते हैं।
scenes.image_prompt: The same young Indian man with short black hair, a kind round face and warm brown eyes, wearing a mustard-yellow kurta, sits at a small wooden desk in a dim cramped office, nodding with a tired smile while three people in different coloured clothes pile heavy files, bags and tiffin boxes onto his desk and arms. One of them points at him, one looks at a phone, one laughs. Foreground: overflowing papers and a cold cup of tea. Middle ground: the three figures leaning over the desk. Background: a window with fading evening light, crowded shelves and a ticking wall clock. Muted deep blue, lavender and ochre tones with a single warm lamp glow on his face. Hand-painted gouache and watercolor storybook illustration with visible brushstrokes, soft paper texture, rich harmonious colours and cinematic light.

scenes.narration: जब तक काम आओगे, सब अपने हैं। एक बार मना किया, तो सारी अच्छाई भुला दी जाती है।
scenes.image_prompt: The same young Indian man with short black hair, a kind round face and warm brown eyes, wearing a mustard-yellow kurta, stands in a narrow village lane at dusk, gently raising one open palm to say no, while four neighbours in saffron, green, maroon and grey clothes turn their backs with crossed arms and walk away. Behind him on the ground lies a trail of small glowing paper lanterns, the favours he did before, now dimming and going out one by one. Foreground: dusty dirt path with extinguished lanterns. Middle ground: the four neighbours walking away. Background: mud houses, an old banyan tree and a stormy burgundy and dark teal sky with a last burnt orange streak. Hand-painted gouache and watercolor storybook illustration with visible brushstrokes, soft paper texture, rich harmonious colours and cinematic light.

scenes.narration: लोग आपकी अच्छाई की क़द्र नहीं करते, उसकी आदत डाल लेते हैं। और आदत की कोई क़ीमत नहीं होती।
scenes.image_prompt: A dreamlike symbolic scene: the same young Indian man with short black hair, a kind round face and warm brown eyes, wearing a mustard-yellow kurta, stands on a floating stone staircase handing out glowing golden coins from a bottomless leather pouch into the open hands of a long queue of faceless people who stretch down into the mist. They take the coins without looking at him, their eyes fixed only on the pouch. Foreground: coins spilling and drifting down like fireflies. Middle ground: the endless queue on floating steps. Background: an oversized pale clock hanging in the sky, misty mountains, deep blue and lavender twilight with a warm amber glow. Hand-painted gouache and watercolor storybook illustration with visible brushstrokes, soft paper texture, rich harmonious colours and cinematic light.

scenes.narration: अच्छे बनिए, पर समझदार भी। जहाँ इज़्ज़त न हो, वहाँ मदद मत कीजिए। अपनी हद तय कीजिए, और ना कहना सीखिए।
scenes.image_prompt: The same young Indian man with short black hair, a kind round face and warm brown eyes, wearing a mustard-yellow kurta, stands tall and calm on a rooftop terrace at sunrise, one hand lifted in a firm but gentle stop gesture toward a small crowd waiting behind a low painted line on the floor that glows soft gold. His face is relaxed and confident. Foreground: a potted tulsi plant and a steaming tea cup on the parapet. Middle ground: the glowing golden line and the crowd held back behind it. Background: a city skyline of water tanks and rooftops under an emerald green and warm orange dawn sky with golden light rays. Hand-painted gouache and watercolor storybook illustration with visible brushstrokes, soft paper texture, rich harmonious colours and cinematic light.

scenes.narration: याद रखिए, अच्छाई कमज़ोरी नहीं है, पर हर किसी पर लुटाना कमज़ोरी बन जाता है। आपका क्या ख़याल है?
scenes.image_prompt: The same young Indian man with short black hair, a kind round face and warm brown eyes, wearing a mustard-yellow kurta, walks along a quiet tree-lined road toward a rising sun, carrying a small glowing brass lantern in one hand, head held high with a gentle smile, his long shadow stretching behind him. At the roadside an elderly woman in a white sari and a small child in a red shirt wave warmly at him. Foreground: fallen golden leaves on the road. Middle ground: the man with the lantern and the two well-wishers. Background: rows of tall trees, soft mist and a glowing sunrise in warm orange and golden yellow with emerald shadows. Hand-painted gouache and watercolor storybook illustration with visible brushstrokes, soft paper texture, rich harmonious colours and cinematic light.
